facts.business: Escorts Kubota Limited is an Indian company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sale of agricultural machinery, including tractors, implements, diesel engines, and related aftermarket services.
key_risks: The business remains cyclical and sensitive to monsoon patterns, farm income volatility, and input cost fluctuations.

Intense competition in the tractor segment, both domestic and global, requires continuous investment in technology, branding, and financing incentives to maintain volume leadership and margin stability.
